prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1102; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Can you confirm you're comfortable with us recording this call?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Great. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was stopped at a red light on a main road in Pasadena, Texas, in the right lane.

Q: What happened next?

A: I was waiting for the light to change, and then I felt a hard impact from behind. My head snapped back and my car was pushed forward into the intersection.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: No. I checked my mirror a moment before, but I didn't notice anything coming. It came up fast.

Q: How fast do you think it was going?

A: I'm not sure. It looked like it was not slowing down at all.

Q: Were you able to drive your vehicle afterward?

A: It was drivable, but the back bumper was damaged and it was hard to drive comfortably. I pulled over to the side of the road.

Q: Did you get medical attention?

A: Yes. An ambulance came, and I was taken to the emergency room. My right knee hit the dashboard, and it has been swollen and painful since then.

Q: Are you still experiencing pain in the knee?

A: Yes. Bending it hurts, and walking up stairs is difficult. I've been using a brace and I'm seeing a physical therapist.

Q: Have you missed any work because of the injury?

A: I've missed several days, and I'm still working out what my schedule will look like.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I'm just hoping the knee gets better and everything gets sorted out.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
